content: Yusufor šoppon
Yakub Kenan dešot taka šuru goijje, ze dešot hibar baf bidešitta hisabe takkil.
In oilde Yakubor bongšor kahani.
Yusuf, ek hõtoro bosojja zuwan, báiyaindor fũwati soolor zãk okkol soraito; hiba gura bafor bouwain Bilhah edde Zilpar futaindor fũwati takito, edde hitarar ku-asaror babute hóbor bafor hãse anito.
Israile hibar fuwain beggunottuwaro Yusufore beši ador gorito, kiyollahoile hite aššilde hibar bura halor fut; hitare ugguwa lamba kuruta banai dil.
Hitarar bafe Yusufore hitarattuwaro beši ador gorede dekiyore, hitare ingša gorito edde hitar loi hono hota šundor gori hoi no farito.
Bade Yusufe ek šoppon deikke, edde hin zehon hitar báiyaindore hoiye, hitara Yusufore aro beši ingša goijje.
Hibaye hitarare hodde, "Funo, ãi ekkan šoppon dekki:
So, ãra gĩyũ kũṛat tara bandir, ar so, ãr tarawa uṛi tiyaiye, ar tũwarar taragune ãr tarawar sairo ḍakottu tiyaiyore hibare soida goijje."
Toi hitar báiyainde hitare hodde, "Tui ki hãsa ãrar uwore razagiri goribi? Tui ki hãsa ãrar uwore šašon solaibi?" Hitar šoppon edde hotalla buli hitara hitare aro beši ingša goijje.
Bade Yusufe aro ekkan šoppon deikke, edde hiyanore hitar báiyaindore hoiye. Hite hodde, "So, ãi aro ekkan šoppon dekilam, ar so, beile, sande edde egarowa taraye ãre soida goredde dekilam."

Hite zehon hitar bafore edde báiyaindore hoiye, bafe hitare dõk diye edde hodde, "Tui in hondilla šoppon dekkili? Ãi, tor ma edde tor báiyain okkol, beggune aiyore ki hãsa tor sarme meṛit soida foijjum?"
Hitar báiyainde hitar loi riš gora šuru goijje, kintu hitar bafe he hota monot rakidiye.
Yusufore báiyainde besifelaiye
Ek bar Yusufor báiyainde Šekimot hitarar bafor soolor zãk soraito giye,
toi Israile Yusufore hodde, "Tor báiyainde Šekimot soolor zãk soradde no ne? Ikka ai, ãi tore hitarar hãse defeṛai." Yusufe hodde, "Oto, ãi aišši."
Toi bafe hodde, "Tui zaiyore tor báiyain edde soolor zãkgun ken ase nai sagoi, edde aiyore ãr hãse zanais." Toi hibaye hitare Hebronor ḍeilottu defeṛaiye. Yusuf Šekimot fõsiyore,
ekzon manuše hitare lot faiye, ar so, maṛot gura fira goredde dekiyore he manušwaye fusar goredde: "Tui kiyor talaš gorodde?"
Yusufe hodde, "Ãi ãr báiyaindor talaš goridde, meherbani gori ãre ekka ho, hitara goru sool hoṛe sorar?"
Manušwaye hodde, "Hitara entu giyegoi. Ãi hitara 'Aio, ãra Dotanot zai' hen hodde funnilam." Toi Yusufe báiyaindor talašot Dotanot giye, heṛe hitarar lot faiye.
Hitara Yusuf aiyedde durottu loti deikke edde hitarar hãse no fõsibar agottu, hitara hitare marifelaibolla felain goijje.
Hitara ekzonore ekzone hodde, "Oi so, šoppon dekoya aiyer!
Aio, ãra hitare mari felai, bade hono ek faṭkuwat felai di, bade hoiyum, hitare hono fahari zanuware hái felaiye. Tarfore hitar šopponor doša ki o saiyum."
Kintu Rubene zehon ei hota funniye, hitarar hatottu Yusufore basaito saiye. Hite hodde: "No, ãra hitare zane mari no felai,

lou no bayo; hitare eṛe bošotisara elehar ei faṭkuwat maze felai do, kintu hitar uwore hat no tuillo." Rubene endilla hoiyede oilde Yusufore hitarar hatottu basaibolla edde hitare bafor hãse uwafes firai loizai faribolla.
Toi Yusuf zehon báiyaindor hãse fõisse, hitar gat finda aššilde he šundojja lamba kurutawa faṛi kuli loifelaye.
Toi hitara hibare dori faṭkuwawat felai diye. Faṭkuwawa hali aššil, ar heṛe hono fani no aššil.

Tarfore hitara hána haito boišše, hen šomot hitara suk tuli saiye, ar so, Giliyad name ek zagattu ek dol Ismaili šodori goroya aiyer. Hitara ũṛor fiṛot gori kušbo mosolla, rezom edde duf, hin okkol loi Mišor dešot zadde.
Toi Ehudaye hitar báiyaindore hodde, "Báiware marifelaiyore lukai erile ãrar ki lab oibo?
Aio, ãra hitare ei Ismaili okkolor hãse besifelai, hitar gat hat no di, kiyollahoile hite to ãrar nizor bái, ek lou-gustor." Ar hitar báiyainde he hota fuinne.

Toi Midiyaniyo šodori goroya okkol zehon hitarar ḍake aišše, hitara Yusufore faṭkuwattu tuille ṭani tuille edde kuriwa rufar ṭiyar bodole hitare he Ismaili okkolor hãse besifelaiye, ar hitara Yusufore Mišorot loiainne.
Bade Rubene faṭkuwar ḍake firi giye edde dekedde Yusuf heṛe nai, henot hite nizor hor faiṭṭe,
hitar báiyaindor hãse firi giye edde hodde: "Fuwawa to nai, ãi hoṛe zaiyum?"
Bade hitara Yusufor kurutawa loiye, ar uggwa soolor so zorgorai he kurutaware louwot buraiye.
Toi hitara he lamba kurutaware hitarar bafor hãse defeṛaiye edde hodde: "Ãra iba faiyi. Tũi bala gori so iba tũwar futor kuruta oi ne naki no?"
Hibaye kurutawa sini faijje edde hodde, "Iba to ãr futor kuruta, hitare hono fahari zanuware hái felaiye. Yusufore hameka hanhan gorifelaiye."
Toi Yakube hibar nizor hoor faiṭṭe, kĩyailot salar šoṭ berai bout din foijjonto fuwalla šuk goijje.
Hibar hár futain edde ziyainde hibare šantona dito saiye, kintu hiba hono bote šanti no o, aro hodde, "Ãi šuk goitte goitte ãr fuwar hãse fatalot zaiyumboi." Ar bafe futolla handat roiye.
Ar eṛe Midiyaniyo okkole Yusufore Mišor dešot Feruwanor ofisar okkolor butore Putifar name ekzon fahardar okkolor soddaror hãse besifelaiye.
